pages.text: Two more packages from $(l)dyc3/meatballcraft-infra$(); register it first (see NuclearCraft Monitoring).$(li)$(l)oppm install explore$(): browse components, their methods and docs$(li)$(l)oppm install provision-drive$(): set up a new server drive with OpenOS and OPPM. It erases the drive you pick.
$(l)E-Tank Fluid Manager$() by mantikafasi (from peachey2k2): a searchable list of which fluid is on which colour frequency. Needs MineOS.
